changes: Replace all four dependencies with native Node 24/Bun streams and public reads.
Preserve delayed attachment, dynamic replacement, drain backpressure, nested corking and subclassing.
Do not mutate options; honor object-mode highWaterMark and preserve falsy end values.
Settle active and queued operations on destruction; detach adapter listeners and destroy shared children once.
Surface premature close as ERR_STREAM_PREMATURE_CLOSE instead of silently closing.
Preserve normal upload completion without destroying the pending HTTP response.
upstreamTestAdaptations: Change only the import and add an ERR_STREAM_PREMATURE_CLOSE assertion to the upstream close test for VPM.
Keep all 16 original cases and 37 assertions; VPM has 38 assertions with the additional close-error check.
